name: live-memory
description: Persistent, LLM-backed codebase memory. Observes Shofer's own file activity and external edits, accumulates a per-workspace knowledge log, and answers investigative questions from it via the `ask_live_memory` tool — a first-party dogfood of the plugin architecture.
author: Shofer

skills.name: live-memory-stats
skills.description: Show the Live Memory plugin's current status for this workspace — agent state, context-window fill, retained observations and Q&A pairs, session token cost, and the pending question queue.

skills.name: live-memory-config
skills.description: View or change the Live Memory plugin's configuration — the provider profile the memory LLM uses, retention caps, the external-edit watch glob, the compaction interval, and the context-window budget/threshold.

skills.name: live-memory-empty
skills.description: Empty the Live Memory for this workspace — wipe its accumulated observation/Q&A log, persisted conversation window, and cost ledger so the next question starts from a blank slate.

commands.name: show-chat
commands.description: Open / focus the Live Memory chat panel to watch the memory agent's live conversation and state.

commands.name: clear-context
commands.description: Clear the Live Memory agent's in-flight context window (keeps the accumulated observation/Q&A log).

commands.name: empty
commands.description: Empty the Live Memory for this workspace — wipe the accumulated observation/Q&A log, the persisted conversation, and the cost ledger.

profileRef.description: Provider-profile name/id the memory LLM uses (ctx.ai.buildHandler). Empty ⇒ the host default profile.

maxObservations.description: How many recent activity observations to retain per workspace.

maxQuestions.description: How many recent question/answer pairs to retain per workspace.

watchGlob.description: Glob (under the granted filesystem roots) watched for external edits via ctx.host.watch.

compactIntervalMs.description: Background maintenance-service interval (ms) for compacting the observation log into a running summary. 0 disables it.
